final.memo:
We remain constructive on our core earnings-inflection thesis, yet the current market tape demands discipline. Our portfolio is currently weighted toward concentrated AI-linked winners, a theme that has delivered returns but now carries significant correlation risk [D03], [D05]. When individual winners share a single capital-spending and momentum factor, diversification becomes an illusion; a sell-off in one can trigger a liquidity-driven liquidation across the entire basket [D05].

Given the S&P 500's trailing multiple of nearly 28x and the tightening equity risk premium against the 10-year Treasury, the risk-reward skew has narrowed [D04]. We are moving to HEDGE, not out of a lack of conviction in our individual event-driven catalysts, but to ensure that our gross exposure does not leave us vulnerable to a thematic squeeze [D01], [D05]. We will trim winners that have hit our valuation targets and deploy index-level protection to anchor the portfolio against broad market volatility [D01], [D04]. This is a defensive recalibration to ensure we remain liquid and ready to capitalize when the inevitable regime volatility creates a wider discount in our target names.
